peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Lower relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Lower relative price than most peers: 28.2% below its local comparables; 5 of 130 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (89.7): 5.8 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 351 of 393 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 50% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Mountbatten MRT about 470 m, Aljunied MRT about 590 m; closer than 367 of 662 similar developments (the same as 15). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 3 within 2 km; nearest Kong Hwa School about 630 m; more than 292 of 662 similar developments (the same as 254). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 310 m), more than 362 of 662 similar developments (the same as 63); nearest hawker centre Kallang Estate Fresh Market And Food Centre about 430 m; nearest park Wilkinson Interim Park about 1,060 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Kallang Estate Fresh Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Zyanya, 2 new sales, about 340 m; Grand Dunman, 72 new sales, about 970 m; Arina East Residences, 85 new sales, about 1,260 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,380 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 1,680 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 1,840 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 1,910 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 1,910 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 267 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 413 new sales and 575 resales (988 purchases); new sales were 41.8% of these purchases. Subsales (66) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Tanjong Rhu Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,560 m; Kallang Close GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,640 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 575 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 150 of 662 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 575 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 709 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−18.9%). Planning-area private resales −17.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
